description: What 14 CFR 91.211 asks of a flight up to `highest_ft` MSL, in a pilot's words: in an airplane with no pressurised cabin, its cabin at the altitude flown, (a)(1) over 12,500 ft the crew's oxygen for any of it past 30 minutes, (a)(2) over 14,000 ft the crew's for all of it, (a)(3) over 15,000 ft every occupant provided with it, none where it carries supplemental oxygen; with a pressurised cabin, (b)(1)(i) above FL250 a 10-minute supply for every occupant (none where it carries oxygen) and (b)(1)(ii) above FL350 one pilot at the controls wearing a mask. Each height is the rule's "above". Null where none is asked.

highest_ft.description: The highest altitude flown, feet MSL.

supplemental_oxygen.description: The airplane carries supplemental oxygen; false, the safer side, where not known.
